events.title: 2026 Iran War — Strait of Hormuz Crisis (Ongoing, Escalating)
events.description: Strait of Hormuz largely blocked since Feb 28, 2026. US-Israel air war against Iran. IRGC attacking merchant ships, sea mines deployed. ~20,000 mariners stranded. Brent peaked at /bbl. Renewed hostilities in late July shattered June MOU ceasefire. Houthi threats to join conflict. Kuwait under drone attack. Tanker struck in strait.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — DRC, WHO Global Health Emergency
events.description: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Bundibugyo ebolavirus (no approved vaccine/treatment). Spread to 4+ provinces in DRC. WHO declared global health emergency. US citizen infected. UN opening largest treatment centre. Outbreak intensifying at exceptional pace.
events.source: WHO, UN News, Wikipedia, EU Health Commission

events.title: Rare Joint Japan-South Korea-US FX Intervention
events.description: Unprecedented coordinated FX intervention by Japan, South Korea, and US to prop up yen and won. First joint action in 15 years. Won hit 9-month high. Yen carry trade volatility rising. Signals deep concern about currency stability.

events.title: BOJ Holds Rates at 1%, Warns of Rapid Rate Hikes
events.description: BOJ held rates at 1% (8-1 vote, Takata dissented calling for 1.25%). Governor Ueda warned of rapid rate hikes if inflation target fails. Japan intervened to prop up yen ahead of BOJ decision. Core inflation exceeding 2% target.

events.title: Oil Supply Disruption — Largest in History of Global Oil Market (IEA)
events.description: IEA characterizes Iran war/Strait of Hormuz closure as largest supply disruption in history of global oil market. Brent at .92 (fell 5.69% in 24h but was at  peak). Oil +23% in July after renewed hostilities shattered June ceasefire. OPEC+ increasing quotas. Houthi Red Sea disruption adding 5-6 mb/d at risk.

domain_notes.us_fed: Fed held rates at 3.6% on July 29 (9-3 vote, 3 dissents). New Chair Warsh. No emergency action. Fifth straight hold.
domain_notes.latam: Argentina debt tensions with Brazil (R default to Casa da Moeda). IMF praises Argentina reforms. 2027 debt hurdle looming. Not category-5.
domain_notes.eu_ecb: ECB rates unchanged at 2.25%. No emergency action. Governing Council meeting in Berlin.
domain_notes.uk: BoE in wait-and-see mode. Gilts rundown may slow to £50bn. No emergency. Sterling soft but stable.
domain_notes.china: PBOC pledging timely policy adjustment, appropriately loose monetary policy. Undervalued currency (>20%). No emergency.
domain_notes.africa: Sudan civil war ongoing. Sahel jihadist insurgency. Debt crises across multiple nations. Chronic but not category-5 breaking.
domain_notes.financial_system: Russia warned of potential systemic banking crisis by Oct 2026. ECB research on interbank lending contraction. Not acute this week.
